descriptionChirho: Qal: to be strong, bold, or courageous; to prevail or be stronger than another.
Piel: to strengthen, make firm, or encourage someone or something; causative of the Qal sense.
Piel with negative nuance: to harden the heart or spirit, making someone stubborn or obstinate.
Hifil: to cause someone to take courage or be bold; jussive exhortation for another to show courage.
Hitpael reflexive: to strengthen oneself, show determination, or exert oneself with resolve.
Hitpael idiomatic: to exert oneself to the point of haste or urgent pressing forward.
